steps.en: OCMS fetches the latest registered address of a person or company
steps.id: OCMS mengambil registered address terbaru orang atau perusahaan
steps.why_en: Only personal ID holders are covered; the company address lookup is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Hanya pemegang NRIC yang tercakup; pengambilan alamat perusahaan dimatikan di pengaturan production.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether the registered and furnished addresses match
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah alamat terdaftar dan alamat furnish cocok
steps.why_en: Nothing compares the two addresses; the registered address is stored without looking at the furnished one.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembandingan kedua alamat; alamat terdaftar disimpan tanpa melihat alamat furnish.

steps.en: If they match, OCMS carries on with the updated details
steps.id: Jika cocok, OCMS lanjut dengan data yang sudah diperbarui
steps.why_en: The process always continues with the furnished address; it is not decided by any match result.
steps.why_id: Proses selalu lanjut dengan alamat furnish; tidak ditentukan oleh hasil pencocokan apa pun.

steps.en: If they differ, OCMS sends a work item to the OIC dashboard
steps.id: Jika beda, OCMS mengirim work item ke dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that does nothing, and the staff portal has no page for such items.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang tidak berbuat apa-apa, dan portal staff tidak punya halaman untuk item itu.
